For a flush mount installation into a DBB or 4" square box, two #8-32 screws are required, whereas a surface mount installation using an SLSPBBC backbox requires two #8 thread cutting screws.
Models QMX6.P70 and QMX6.P74 are the only variants in the series that include both the CO2 sensor and the air quality indicator features1.
The Siemens QMX6 air quality indicator uses sun icons with three distinct colors to represent bad, fair, and good air quality. These LED colors are red, orange, and green respectively.
To produce a Code 3 Tone (500 Hz ANSI S3.41 temporal pattern), switch SW1 must have POS 2 set to 0, POS 3 set to 1, and POS 4 set to 1.
The maximum depth for a Type 4X surface mount device is 4.25 inches, while the depth for a Type 3R flush mount device is significantly shallower at 1.75 inches.

The relative intensity of the D65 illuminant increases steadily from approximately 0 at 300 nm to a peak of roughly 0.8 at 410 nm, before showing a slight dip and then rising again toward 1.0 at 440 nm.
The ColorScoutA3+ is the optional XY automatic color-measurement stage used to automate the measurement of large-format color charts.
The PXR controller connects to the primary plant level using the BACnet/LON protocol and to room-level devices, such as RXC controllers, via the LONWORKS protocol.
A continuously on red STATUS LED indicates that a hardware fault was detected during the self-test, and the manual states that the PXR must be replaced.

The SITRANS LR120 Modbus variant uses brown and blue for power supply, and black (+) and white (-) for Modbus data, requiring a voltage of 8 to 30 V DC. It operates with a current of 30 mA at 8 V DC or 17 mA at 30 V DC.
The SITRANS LR120 4"/DN100 adapter flange has a maximum B.C.D. of 191 mm and a minimum B.C.D. of 175 mm for its eight slotted holes.
The SITRANS Probe LU240 must be mounted vertically and positioned away from the vessel walls to avoid internal rungs, pipes, and seams, as well as the path of the incoming material stream.

The SITRANS Probe LU240 reaches a total height of 231.4 mm with the Bluetooth adapter, which also extends the enclosure width by 51 mm, while the optional flange adapter provides a mounting base 190 mm wide.

The SITRANS TDL HMI organizes data into specific views including a single-value display, an alarm view, a six-value overview, and a combined view showing one value alongside a graphical trend diagram. These screens allow operators to simultaneously monitor the measurement results, device status, and historical data trends.

The purging gas input for the SITRANS TDL is located on the bottom of the sensor side and at the process flange, while the output for purging on the sensor side is located on the top of the housing. The gas is injected into the process interface and enters the process via the purging tube to prevent condensation or dust deposits.

In a WYE system, the Siemens TPS3 11 is connected to three hot wires, one neutral wire (N), and one ground wire (G). Conversely, a DELTA & HRG WYE configuration uses three hot wires and one ground wire (G), but does not utilize a neutral connection.

The wall cutout for a Siemens TPS3 11 must be approximately 6\ 3/4" tall by 6\ 1/16" wide. Additionally, the wall cavity must provide at least 3.75" of clearance depth to accommodate the unit's 4.0" deep chassis.

Repositioning the S1 connector changes the flow characteristic from an equal-percentage curve (log) when connected to pins A and C to a linear curve (lin) when connected to pins B and C2. This adjustment determines whether the volumetric flow rate increases proportionally or exponentially relative to the DC 0...10 V or 0...1000 Omega positioning signal.

The Siemens SQD actuators have a total height of 111 mm after being fitted to a valve, but they require a minimum clearance of > 100 mm from walls or ceilings and > 200 mm for mounting, connection, operation, and service. Other key dimensions include a housing width of 128 mm and a depth of 80 mm.

The PXC001-E.D system controller specifically features a network interface RJ45 for BACnet/IP at position 5 and an HMI interface at position 9, whereas the PXC001.D utilizes those positions for a LONWORKS plug-in screw terminal block and a different RJ45 interface for operator units and tools.

The Desigo PX system controller has a maximum horizontal width of 271.5 mm and a vertical height of 149.4 mm. When considering the mounting rail, the distance between the top and bottom mounting sliders is 133.5 mm.

The "Add Master" card features a yellow badge icon with a plus sign, while the "Void Master" has a yellow badge icon with a minus sign. Functionally, the Add Master is used to introduce new user badges into the system memory, whereas the Void Master is used to delete or deny access to existing badges.

The "Night lock" status is indicated by a red LED associated with a crescent moon symbol, while the "Program" mode is indicated by a red LED next to a square icon containing the letter "P". Both indicators are part of a vertical array on the reader face used to provide visual feedback during configuration and access events.
If a light barrier is not used, terminal 6 of the X6 connector must be wired to terminal 2 of the X4 output connector, while terminal 5 of X6 is wired to terminal 1 of X4.
The sub-menu options under the "Monitor" main menu include "Door status", "Input signals", and "Output signals".

The standard Hure Head has a horizontal offset of 533 mm and a vertical offset of 290 mm, while the New Hure Head increases the horizontal offset to 577 mm and decreases the vertical offset to 278 mm.
Beyond 250 rpm, the LAGUN GCM motor operates in a constant power zone of 28/34.5 kW where the available power remains stable while torque decreases as speed increases.

To select the slow (filtered) reset filter for a channel, the jumper must be placed in the "SLW" position, while the "FST" position is used to select the fast (unfiltered) reset response. These jumpers are located on the printed circuit board as part of the initial module configuration process.

In 4X Quadrature mode, the module increments the count on every rising and falling edge of both input A and input B when A leads B. Conversely, it decrements the count on every rising and falling edge of both inputs when input B leads input A.

The dielectric strength of air insulation decreases as the site altitude increases due to lower air density. For an installation at 2500 m, a Siemens 3AH5 vacuum circuit-breaker requires a lightning impulse withstand voltage of 90 kV under reference atmosphere to achieve a requested 75 kV level, calculated using an altitude correction factor (Ka) of 1.2

In the Siemens 3AH5 vacuum circuit-breaker, the switching movement is transferred from the operating mechanism box to the pole assemblies by means of operating rods and levers. These pole assemblies are physically secured to the mechanism box through the use of post insulators.
For a rated load of 10 t, the SIWAREX WL250 ST-S SA load cell has a height (H) of 177.8 mm (7.00 inches) and a width (L) of 112.78 mm (4.44 inches).
